dataset.prior_consumption: Original 37-symbol data consumed in legacy and initial campaigns; BTC/ETH historical download is not a fresh holdout

hypothesis.discriminator: Earlier volume-backed shocks and generic volatility expansion failed; this tests the competing low-participation mechanical-impact explanation.
hypothesis.entry: reverse the extreme close at the next open
hypothesis.failure: low-volume dislocations do not reverse consistently or cannot clear realistic friction
hypothesis.feature: 96-bar trailing mean range and volume, current closed-candle range ratio, volume ratio, close-location pressure and symbol-specific base-cost hurdle
hypothesis.mechanism: An extreme close in a wide candle without commensurate volume may be a thin-liquidity price vacuum rather than informed flow and may mean-revert after the bar closes.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across both frozen cost-hurdle variants

limitations: universe selected in September 2026, survivorship/selection bias
no historical L2, queue, trade-side flow or point-in-time instrument rules
OHLCV volume is total base volume, not aggressive buy volume
fee tiers are a dated observed account schedule, not a historical fee time series
instrument minimums are current snapshots, not point-in-time historical rules
spread assumptions are max(3bps, old snapshot median), not observed historical spreads
funding uses settled historical rates and entry-notional approximation; historical mark missing
BTC/ETH fees are conservative explicit proxies, not measured account-specific history
BTC/ETH spread is max(3bps, one current snapshot); not historical L2 spread
reused consumed data is not fresh validation
OHLCV cannot identify aggressor side, depth, liquidation or queue state
base volume is not directly comparable across symbols
current fees, spreads and instrument rules approximate history
taker execution only; no maker or queue inference
selection: no within-search winner selection; both cost-hurdle variants evaluated on every forward fold and Holm-corrected
